title: The interview hack that works every single time

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 70% of interviews go south because of one mistake?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This hack is changing how top companies hire right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s asking one question that reveals everything about a candidate.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The question is: “Tell me about a time you failed and what you learned.”

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s used by Google and Microsoft to spot real problem-solvers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: failure shows growth, not weakness — and that’s what they want.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s the one question you’ve been asked in an interview?

caption_text: The interview hack that works every single time
